task: independent L1 re-fetch spot check #4 (G-LIT), class-bound to AF-SCC-C0-VAC-GEN / AF-SCC-C2-VAC-GEN

eligible_frame.definition: data rows whose class_mapping contains AF-SCC-C0-VAC-GEN or AF-SCC-C2-VAC-GEN, minus rows independently re-fetched at the pinned hash by spot check #3 (SRC-065, SRC-080, SRC-081)

sampling_rule.S1: eligible rows sorted by citation_id ascending; every 4th starting at index 1 (1-based)
sampling_rule.S2_targeted_augmentation: SRC-091 added: newest AF-SCC-C0-VAC-GEN row contributed in the 00:08 rebuild and load-bearing for T-515/T-528; declared before any fetch

locator_policy: Re-fetch each row from its own primary locator host, never from ledger text: arXiv rows -> https://export.arxiv.org/api/query?id_list=<arxiv_id>; INSPIRE rows -> the row's evidence_url (inspirehep.net/api/literature/<recid>); OpenAlex rows -> the row's evidence_url (api.openalex.org/works/...). Raw response body is hashed.
comparison_policy: title (normalized exact / token Jaccard), first-author family, year against fetched issued/journal metadata, DOI where present, and evidence_excerpt content-token coverage against the fetched abstract (elisions allowed). Ledger verdict/status columns are NOT trusted as evidence.
falsifier: Any sampled locator that resolves to a different work, any fetched abstract that contradicts its ledger excerpt, or a re-run at the same pinned csv sha256 producing a different verdict set, falsifies this artifact's MATCH set and turns the spot-check verdict to revise.
independence_note: Disjoint from spot check #3 rows (SRC-041,049,057,065,073,080,081,089); spots #1/#2 (flash-10 rows 1-20, flash-11 rows 21-40) were taken against earlier csv revisions and are not hash-pinned to the frozen revision.
